questions.stem: The SITAR is most associated with which maestro?
questions.explanation: Pandit Ravi Shankar (1920-2012) — legendary sitar player, introduced Indian classical music to the West (played at Woodstock, taught George Harrison). Bharat Ratna 1999. Daughter: Anoushka Shankar.

questions.stem: Match the MAESTRO with the INSTRUMENT. A. Zakir Hussain.  B. Bismillah Khan.  C. Amjad Ali Khan.  D. Hariprasad Chaurasia. List-II: 1. Tabla.  2. Shehnai.  3. Sarod.  4. Flute (Bansuri).
questions.explanation: Zakir Hussain — tabla (son of Ustad Alla Rakha). Bismillah Khan — shehnai (Bharat Ratna 2001). Amjad Ali Khan — sarod (son of Hafiz Ali Khan). Hariprasad Chaurasia — bansuri (flute).
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Indian music & musical instruments — mixed tiers

questions.explanation: Tabla — membranophone percussion. Two drums: dayan (right, smaller, tuned) + bayan (left, larger, bass). String instruments = sitar, veena, sarod (chordophone). Wind = flute, shehnai, nadaswaram.

questions.stem: 'MRIDANGAM' is a primary percussion instrument of:
questions.explanation: Mridangam — primary rhythm accompaniment in Carnatic (South Indian) classical. Tabla plays this role in Hindustani (North Indian) classical. Other key Carnatic percussion: ghatam (clay pot), kanjira, morsing.

questions.stem: The 'THREE JEWELS (Trimurti)' of Carnatic music are:

options.option_text: Bismillah Khan, Ravi Shankar, M.S. Subbulakshmi

questions.explanation: The Carnatic Trinity (Mummoortigal) — contemporaries of the early 19th century — Tyagaraja (1767-1847), Muthuswami Dikshitar (1775-1835), Syama Sastri (1762-1827). Together composed the bulk of the classical kriti repertoire. All three lived in and around Tiruvarur (TN).

questions.stem: M. S. Subbulakshmi — the first Indian musician to receive the BHARAT RATNA (1998) — was a famed vocalist of:
questions.explanation: M.S. Subbulakshmi (1916-2004) — Carnatic vocalist. First Indian musician with Bharat Ratna (1998). Sang at UN General Assembly 1966. Known for Venkateswara Suprabhatam and bhajans. Also first musician Magsaysay awardee (1974).

questions.stem: The SAROD is the signature instrument of:

options.option_text: Ustad Ali Akbar Khan / Amjad Ali Khan family

questions.explanation: Sarod — short-necked fretless lute, metal fingerboard, rich bass. Ustad Ali Akbar Khan (Maihar gharana) and Ustad Amjad Ali Khan family are its foremost exponents. Shiv Kumar Sharma = santoor. Chaurasia = bansuri. Kishori Amonkar = Hindustani vocal (Jaipur gharana).
